rubric_notes: Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Complete and precise: 2.08-stable, a.22/47112, a.22.1/47113, four families with correct SUNIDs, protein-level members (TAF(II)s, NC2, NF-Y, CHRAC, Sos, Aq_328, TTHA1479), a.22.1.0 'not a true family' annotation, and the bacterial-family two-repeat comment, all verified against the bundle. Correctly frames superfamily as probable common ancestry while preserving family separation, explicitly refuses to transfer octamer formation, DNA packaging, TF function, oligomeric state, substrate or ligand specificity, and names outside evidence needed. Correctly contrasts linker H1/H5 in a.4.5.13 as a different fold. No errors.

Correct families, superfamily, fold, class with SUNIDs and boundaries matching the bundle. Superfamily and fold comments cited are present in the bundle and correctly framed as structural context, not functional proof. Explicit, thorough list of unsafe transfers and required external evidence. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

States all three family SCCS and SUNIDs (53068, 53083, 53089), superfamily c.55.1/53067, fold c.55/53066, all confirmed by the evidence bundle (parents, children, homology endpoints with homology_scope sf). Correctly identifies the superfamily as the deepest shared node implying probable common ancestry, explicitly rejects same-family status, same reaction/substrate/ligand specificity/regulation/whole-protein function/template interchangeability, and lists external evidence types needed. Correctly notes fold level does not add homology support. No material omissions or errors.

Complete. Correct identifiers for all three families, superfamily 47240, fold 47239, class 46456, with parents responses in bundle confirming the lineage. Interprets superfamily as probable common origin while the family split forbids upgrading to same reaction chemistry; explicitly rejects each cross-family transfer and names sequence/structure residue correspondences, metal-bound structures, biochemical data, and phylogenetic evidence as required. Correct statements about empty homology warnings and the PF05067 comment; correct note that a.25 fold membership outside a.25.1 is only structural similarity. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All must_include criteria met: b.6.1.1/49504, b.6.1.5/74874, b.6.1.6/110107 under Cupredoxins b.6.1/49503; states probable common ancestry at superfamily level, not same-family or functional equivalence; explicitly rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer, cites the 'lacking the metal-binding site' annotations for ephrin and PAD4 families, and names metal-site, biochemical, structural-alignment evidence as prerequisites. All identifiers and annotations supported by bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

SCCS and SUNIDs for the three families, superfamily, and fold verified against the bundle. States probable common ancestry and shared beta-grasp core while keeping families distinct; rejects transfer of covalent modifier processing, UBX cofactor/binding roles, Ras/Rap binding, ligand specificity, and whole-protein function from superfamily placement alone, and lists required external evidence. Correctly treats SPACI/AEROSPACI as structure-quality context for template choice, not evolutionary evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Complete: correct SCCS and SUNIDs for superfamily, fold, class, and all three families, all bundle-supported. States superfamily-level remote homology, not a single close family, and explicitly says it is not evidence that the whole multidomain proteins perform the same job (domain recruitment). Cites the KaiA receiver-feature annotation; rejects transfer of two-component signaling, receiver chemistry, ODC catalysis/substrate specificity, KaiA circadian function, ligand, oligomeric state, and template status; names needed external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Correct lineage with SUNIDs 310577/310616, both V1 and A1 bulge proteins in the single family, sibling superfamilies, fold comment, PubMed xref, all verified by children/annotations endpoints. Clearly scoped claim: b.84.5 asserts probable common ancestry, b.84.5.1 is the closer family grouping, fold sharing supports topology not superfamily-level homology, and is not evidence of analogy/convergence; rejects function/motif/template transfer across the fold and names the external evidence needed. Several bundle searches returned empty results, but the answer does not rely on them.

Correct 2.08 fold/superfamily/family hierarchy with SUNIDs, fold core comment, superfamily comments, and fold-level homology warning, all supported by the bundle. Explicitly states the deepest shared node is the fold, that 'possible link' is not a merge, and that both a homology claim and the opposite convergence claim would require external structural alignment, heme-ligand/core-sequence correspondence, domain-context or phylogenetic evidence (strong convergence control and calibration). No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct family, superfamily, fold and class identifiers with SUNIDs, supported. States that SCOPe supports probable common ancestry via c.2.1 while separate families warn against transferring ADH chemistry, CoA binding, K-channel regulation, NAD vs NADP preference, whole-protein function, oligomeric state or templates; distinguishes domain-level from whole-chain inference; correctly cites the c.2.1.1 comment, the PF02254 mapping and the fold-level homology warning, all present in the bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. States shared class k / fold k.40 / superfamily k.40.1 / family k.40.1.1 (SUNID 100905), quotes the 'not a true family' comment, explains that the annotation blocks ordinary family-level homology inference, and frames the safe description as a grouping of synthetic coiled-coil designs with limits on function/oligomer/template transfer. All identifiers match the evidence bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct 1.69 and 2.08 placements with SIDs, SUNIDs, boundary 1-118, fold/superfamily/family codes and names. Clear statement that the pair moved from class-only to same-superfamily (c.23.14) probable common ancestry while remaining in families c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1. Explicitly limits inference (no activity, ligand state, oligomer, or template transfer) and notes SCOPe records do not expose the structural-alignment rationale. Ligand comment is supported by the bundle.

Correct boundaries (9-111 vs 1-8), SUNID 343393, full class l / l.1.1.1 Tags / N-terminal Tags / Synthetic lineage, and homology endpoint facts (homology_implied_by_level=false, artifact_not_homology_evidence) all supported by bundle. Clearly states tag similarity is not evidence tagged proteins are homologous and notes external construct evidence would be needed for stronger claims. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Full release trajectory from 1.75 through 2.03 unchanged, split at 2.04, persisting to 2.08, with correct identifiers, SUNIDs, boundaries, and both lineages. Adds the retrieved 1.75 fold comment on internal regions, notes that sharing only the root is weaker than proof of independent origin, rejects transfer of toxin activity, ligand behavior, oligomeric state, and template use across the split, and names the external evidence that would be needed.

Complete: SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, SCCS all correct; d.394 shown as Prp8-only fold via supported children query; mosaic framing; homology limited to superfamily/family; explicit rejection of catalytic/reader transfer; notes five domains share only root. Evaluator: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: correct family/superfamily/fold/class with SUNIDs, Pfam 03377 repeat comment at superfamily (supported), re flag on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, single-repeat comment, canonical representative repeat; states family homology of repeat architecture with explicit limits and evidence needed for stronger transfers.

Correct release metadata (2.08, 2.08-stable, 2.08-2026-08-16) supported by the current-release body; recommends pinning 2.08 and does not call the periodic label a stable release. Does not say to preserve the dated label when periodic-only entries are used, and describes the periodic label only as status metadata without explaining that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting stable-release domains. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy with SUNIDs, ms records, fragment comments, 1dn1 chain-level split (e.25.1.1 vs a.47.2.1), automated match to d3c98b_. Directly addresses classification revision using the bundled 1.55–1.75 history: no fold/superfamily/family move, the material change is the explicit ms fragment flag. Limits fold/homology interpretation to the represented core, warns absent helices are not deletions, rejects function/binding-mode transfer from fragments without full-domain evidence. Complete on all scoring foci. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correctly names c.2.1, c.3.1, c.31.1, d.58.20 (ferredoxin-like fold, class d) and e.52.1, all supported by cited search and parents responses. States that family/superfamily carry positive evolutionary assertions while fold/class report only structural similarity, that the cross-superfamily spread is consistent with convergent recruitment but SCOPe alone does not prove independent origin, and lists global alignment, core sequence correspondence, motifs in structural context, domain architecture, and phylogeny as needed evidence. Rejects substrate/chemistry/oligomer/template transfer across families. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct release comparison with identifiers and the A:500-644 boundary, moving from class-only sharing in 2.04 to superfamily b.18.1 in 2.08 with families b.18.1.36 and b.18.1.3 kept apart. Notably also warns that the 2.04 fold difference must not be read as proof of convergence or nonhomology, and backs the ancestry hypothesis with the 9-strand jelly-roll fold annotation plus PubMed 17977833 linking ColG, Cry4Ba, and CPE C-terminal domains. Clearly bars transfer of collagen binding, the calcium annotation, and Cry receptor or pore function, and notes only one 1dlc domain is in scope. Eval: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers, SUNIDs, boundaries, and lineage correct and supported. Family-level homology retained; hf correctly defined; d1ztra1 flagged as not an ordinary fold exemplar, to be flagged/excluded for template selection and fold-classification training unless heterogeneity is explicitly modeled; rejects transferring 1ztr coordinates as a template for the 1p7j bundle; supported mutant/NHE caveats; names external evidence needed for stronger transfers. Minor phrasing slip ('identical below the Homeodomain family' when the lineage is identical through species) is not a factual error. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct SUNIDs, boundaries, fr annotation, and bundle-supported quality values (1uc6 NMR 0.0216; 1o5d X-ray 2.05 A 0.2875). Keeps family assignment; coverage-aware alignment only over present core; fragment not sole complete-domain representative, kept in fragment stratum; correctly states SPACI/AEROSPACI measures technical quality, not completeness or representativeness; diversity and function-transfer caveats stated. Slightly indirect about naming the complete domain as default representative, but the implication is clear. Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Hierarchy order cf > sf > fa > protein/species/domain is supported by the /api/v1/levels bundle. Correct choice and semantics: family placement implies an asserted common ancestor plus closer relationship, new superfamily is the conservative claim, new fold only when core arrangement/topology does not fit. Lists non-transferable properties and the external evidence (core alignments, motif conservation, ligand-bound data, domain context, phylogeny, literature) needed for a positive remote-homology claim. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Families d.144.1.4/56171, d.144.1.6/64411, d.144.1.7/88854 under superfamily d.144.1/56112, fold d.144/56111, class d; fold comment on two alpha+beta domains is supported by annotations. States superfamily-level common ancestry and common PK-like architecture, and that the groups are distinct families. Refuses transfer of peptide/aminoglycoside/phosphoinositide substrate choice, activation-loop behavior, lipid or protein-substrate recognition, regulatory-subunit control, and whole-protein regulation. Lists sequence and structural alignments of active-site/specificity residues, ligand-bound structures, biochemical assays, and domain-context/regulatory experiments. Complete.
